day_shape: 62 items: Khamenei orders 'no geographic limits' retaliation target bank, CENTCOM says US Navy has redirected 144 commercial vessels enforcing Iran blockade, Rubio says Trump undecided on strikes, Vance letter to Tehran acknowledged by Araghchi and Rezaei.

threads.label: Khamenei 'no geographic limits' directive cascade
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a series of messages ordering armed forces commanders to update the 'target bank' so all US and Israeli assets fall within range, with no geographic limitation on response. IRGC spokesman Mohebbi, Defence Minister Akhlagi and advisor Salehi echoed the directive in Defa Press statements claiming enhanced readiness for operations beyond West Asia.

threads.label: Vance letter and US-Iran diplomatic track
threads.summary: Iranian Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei said Washington's 'tone' had changed following a letter from US Vice President JD Vance, while Foreign Minister Araghchi called the letter a 'positive step' toward resumed talks. Rezaei set seven conditions before negotiations or reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and said Tehran was debating whether to maintain its ban on nuclear weapons.

threads.label: US military posture and strike deliberations
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 144 commercial vessels as of 31 October enforcing what it called an 'ironclad blockade' against Iran, posting images from USS George Washington and USS George H.W. Bush. Secretary of State Rubio told reporters at the G20 in Atlanta that Trump 'hasn't made a decision' on striking Iran; Trump spoke with Netanyahu by phone Saturday.

threads.label: Evin prison attack litigation and claims
threads.summary: Tehran's civil court opened proceedings on claims from 60 families of '12-day war' martyrs against 16 defendants including the US government, and held a separate hearing on the Evin prison attack case. Defa Press released images it said showed the Israeli strike on Evin, and Tehran's judiciary chief Ehtebati said attacks on prisons constitute a war crime.

threads.label: Regime claims of damage to US bases
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press claimed American media had disclosed new information on 'extensive destruction' of US bases, with Defa Press citing satellite imagery of damage to 26 bases. IRIB also quoted US Senator Chris Murphy saying Iran will emerge 'more powerful' after the war.

threads.label: Hezbollah and Lebanon
threads.summary: Lebanon's Military Court charged 13 Hezbollah members over a half-ton explosives shipment seized en route to Beirut earlier this month. A separate report cited an official saying Hezbollah is unlikely to join any renewed US-Iran hostilities unless Iran's leadership faces an existential threat.

threads.label: Israeli domestic politics on Iran
threads.summary: Democrats leader Yair Golan said Netanyahu lacks public trust and should not lead Israel through another war with Iran. A Jerusalem Post assessment reported Israel is maintaining ambiguity on preparations for escalation while the US extends another negotiating opportunity to Tehran.

events.title_en: Supreme Leader issues message on anniversary of Khorramshahr Liberation Operation in Abadan, enumerates factors of victory for Iranian nation: Victory over the aggressor, armed enemy through national vigilance and steadfastness
events.summary_en: Supreme Leader issues message on anniversary of Khorramshahr Liberation Operation in Abadan, enumerates factors of victory for Iranian nation: Victory over the aggressor, armed enemy through national vigilance and steadfastness. Ayatollah Sayed Mujtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in a message on the anniversary of the Khorramshahr Liberation Operation and the popular epic of expelling Ba'athist aggressors from Abadan Island, whilst explaining the factors of victory and triumph of the Iranian nation in the sacred defence, cited the people's vigilance, faith and divine motivation, the sacrifice and self-devotion of popular forces and their steadfast stand alongside the weaponry of the Army and the Revolutionary Guards as the secret to victory over the aggressor, armed enemy.
